patches_added.name: Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge v2
patches_added.description: Adds the YT Music loadChildren gate fix that prevents the Premium PlaybackState error after Google Clock subscribes. Depends on the base Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge.

patches_removed.name: YT Music MediaBrowser diagnostic logging
patches_removed.description: Safe diagnostic build: starts logging only when Google Clock requests MediaBrowser children; normal YT Music startup is untouched.

patches_modified.name: Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge
patches_modified.description: Short-circuits YT Music's MediaBrowser capability gate before it can publish PlaybackState ERROR(7), keeps browse entitlement metadata coherent, bypasses the DeskClock browse-consent detour, and enables background alarm playback.

patches_removed.name: Diagnostic logging for YouTube Music alarms
patches_removed.description: Writes detailed MediaBrowser diagnostics to Download/ClockMorpheDiag-LAST.txt.

patches_modified.name: Use Morphe YouTube Music for alarms
patches_modified.description: Redirects Google Clock to the Morphe YouTube Music package.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Home Workout Premium. Use with Spoof Signature Verification

patches_added.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_added.description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local Java crash capture.

patches_added.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_added.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_added.name: Enable Live search
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_added.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_added.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_added.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_added.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_added.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_added.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_added.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_added.name: Stop video looping
patches_added.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_removed.name: Enable Open Debug
patches_removed.description: Uses TikTok's hidden Open Debug settings cell as the entry point for Morphe settings. Required for the Morphe settings menu to appear. Supports TikTok 43.8.3.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit of up to 500 videos.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Metra patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
